errors.evidence: The machine-generated description omits the chart's title, '3个数据集平均值' (Average value of 3 datasets), which is crucial for understanding that the data represents an average and not a single experiment.
The description states that at a text length of 10, the MR value is 83.6%. However, the plot shows the value is clearly below the 83.5% level, at approximately 83.47%.

The description states that the MR value at text length 20 is 83.3%. The point on the graph is visibly higher than the midpoint between 83.2 and 83.4, at approximately 83.37%. 83.3% is an under-approximation.
The description claims that the MR value rises to 83.4% at a text length of 30. The plot clearly shows the data point at 30 is below the 83.4% line, at approximately 83.38%.
